question: Should Microsoft Teams adopt `channels.msteams.accounts` plus `defaultAccount`, with one webhook listener port per enabled named bot and legacy root configuration as the implicit default account?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent and proven, but it creates a long-lived public configuration, listener, credential, and persisted-state contract whose acceptance requires Teams-area product intent.

options.title: Accept this contract
options.body: Adopt the proposed account model and per-account listener requirement while retaining the legacy root-level single-account path.

options.title: Require shared-listener multiplexing
options.body: Pause the PR and require multiple bot identities to share one listener through distinct webhook paths before adding the public account surface.

options.title: Decline bundled multi-account support
options.body: Keep Teams single-account and require separate gateway instances for distinct Teams bot identities.

recommendation.title: Accept this contract
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed account model and per-account listener requirement while retaining the legacy root-level single-account path.
